result.instructions: Tools for vCita, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find the client with the email jane@example.com and show her status."; "Which clients were updated since last Monday?"; "List the scheduled appointments for this week.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes vCita data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run vcita_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run vcita_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run vcita_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. vcita_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: vcita_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List or search the business clients (contacts). Returns name, email, phone, status, source and timestamps. Use search_term with search_by to find one client. vCita API: GET /platform/v1/clients.

search_by.description: Field to search in: email, uid, phone or updated_at.

updated_since.description: Only clients updated on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

updated_before.description: Only clients updated on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: vcita_get_client
tools.title: Get client
tools.description: Get one client by ID, with all stored fields. vCita API: GET /platform/v1/clients/{client_id}.

client_id.description: Client ID, for example from vcita_list_clients.

tools.name: vcita_list_client_invoices
tools.title: List client invoices
tools.description: List the invoices of one client. vCita API: GET /platform/v1/clients/{client_id}/invoices.

client_id.description: Client ID, for example from vcita_list_clients.

tools.name: vcita_list_client_payments
tools.title: List client payments
tools.description: List the payments of one client. vCita API: GET /platform/v1/clients/{client_id}/payments.

client_id.description: Client ID, for example from vcita_list_clients.

tools.name: vcita_create_client
tools.title: Create client
tools.description: Create a new client record in the business. Fails with a conflict when a client with the same email already exists. vCita API: POST /platform/v1/clients.

staff_id.description: Staff ID to assign the client to.

source_name.description: Where the client came from, for example a website or referral.

tools.name: vcita_update_client
tools.title: Update client
tools.description: Change fields of one existing client. Send only the fields to change. This tool does not clear fields. vCita API: PUT /platform/v1/clients/{client_id}.

client_id.description: Client ID, for example from vcita_list_clients.

staff_id.description: Staff ID to assign the client to.

tools.name: vcita_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by ID, with line items and status. vCita API: GET /platform/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}.

tools.name: vcita_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List the business payments. Needs the vCita payments module on the business account. vCita API: GET /platform/v1/payments.

tools.name: vcita_get_payment
tools.title: Get payment
tools.description: Get one payment by its UID. vCita API: GET /platform/v1/payments/{payment_uid}.

tools.name: vcita_list_estimates
tools.title: List estimates
tools.description: List the business estimates (quotes). The token needs the payments management permission. vCita API: GET /platform/v1/estimates.

tools.name: vcita_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List appointments on the business calendar. Filter by client and state. Sort with e.g. start_at:ASC. vCita API: GET /platform/v1/scheduling/appointments.

state.description: Comma-separated states: scheduled, done, cancelled, rejected, pending_reschedule, reschedule.

sort.description: Sort order, for example start_at:ASC or updated:DESC.

tools.name: vcita_get_appointment
tools.title: Get appointment
tools.description: Get one appointment by ID. vCita API: GET /platform/v1/scheduling/appointments/{appointment_id}.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with vCita
prompts.description: What you can do with vCita here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_a_client_by_email_and_check_the_record
prompts.title: Find a client by email and check the record
prompts.description: Search the clients by a term, such as an email address. Then read the full record of one client.

prompts.name: review_a_client_s_invoices_and_payments
prompts.title: Review a client's invoices and payments
prompts.description: List the invoices and the payments of one client. Then open one invoice to see its line items and status.

prompts.name: check_the_appointments_on_the_calendar
prompts.title: Check the appointments on the calendar
prompts.description: List the appointments on the business calendar, filtered by client or state. Then open one appointment.

prompts.name: add_a_new_client_record
prompts.title: Add a new client record
prompts.description: Create a client record from the details you pass. The tool fails when a client with the same email already exists.

prompts.name: update_the_details_of_a_client
prompts.title: Update the details of a client
prompts.description: Change the fields you send on one existing client. Fields you do not send stay as they are.
